Static current is iref + I_tail + I_s2 ~ 17 uA (about 31 uW at 1.8 V, assuming iref = 5 uA), leaving margin under 38 uW. The output inverter draws no static current and is sized for dynamic drive of 50 fF, so the rails reach 0.9/0.1 VDD. Delay is gm/C per stage plus slewing into CL."}

```python
VDD = 1.8
GMID_REF, L_REF = 10.0, 0.5   # all nfet mirrors share gm/Id and L with the iref diode so Vgs matches

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":  (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # NMOS input pair gm/Id
    "L_in":     (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),       # input pair length
    "gmid_ld":  (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # PMOS load / pb-mirror gm/Id (keep below ~16 saturation)
    "L_ld":     (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),       # PMOS load length
    "I_tail":   (4e-6, 1e-6, 10e-6),    # stage-1 tail current
    "I_s2":     (8e-6, 2e-6, 15e-6),    # stage-2 CS / load bias current
    "gmid_s2":  (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),      # stage-2 CS gm/Id
    "L_s2":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # stage-2 length
    "I_inv":    (100e-6, 40e-6, 200e-6),# output inverter peak drive (dynamic only, no static draw)
    "L_inv":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),      # inverter length
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    cl = spec["cl"]
    vod = spec["vod"]

    # ibias reference and mirrors: same gm/Id and L as the reference diode
    m0   = lut.size("n", GMID_REF, L_REF, iref, vds=0.6)           # diode at ibias
    mt   = lut.size("n", GMID_REF, L_REF, p["I_tail"], vds=0.6)    # tail source
    mpbn = lut.size("n", GMID_REF, L_REF, p["I_s2"], vds=0.6)      # sinks pb branch

    # stage 1: NMOS pair, PMOS mirror load (M3 diode, M4 output)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.6)

    # stage 2: NMOS CS (gate = out1) with PMOS current-source load (gate = pb)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_s2"], p["L_s2"], p["I_s2"], vds=0.5)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I_s2"], vds=0.6)  # M6 and M7 identical

    # output CMOS inverter
    mon = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["L_inv"], p["I_inv"], vds=0.9)
    mop = lut.size("p", 8.0, p["L_inv"], p["I_inv"], vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("M0",   "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("Mt",   "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("Mpbn", "pb",    "ibias", "vss", "vss", mpbn)
    n.dev("M7",   "pb",    "pb",    "vdd", "vdd", m6)   # pb diode
    # stage 1 (vinp drives the diode-side device -> non-inverting to out1)
    n.dev("M1", "out_a", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1",  "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "out_a", "out_a", "vdd", "vdd", m3)      # diode load
    n.dev("M4", "out1",  "out_a", "vdd", "vdd", m3)      # mirror output
    # stage 2 (inverting)
    n.dev("M5", "out2", "out1", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "out2", "pb",   "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    # output inverter (inverting)
    n.dev("MPo", "vout", "out2", "vdd", "vdd", mop)
    n.dev("MNo", "vout", "out2", "vss", "vss", mon)

    # first-order predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    gm5 = m5.gm
    A2 = gm5 / (m5.gds + m6.gds)
    Ainv = (mon.gm + mop.gm) / (mon.gds + mop.gds)

    C1 = m5.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = mon.cgg + mop.cgg + m5.cdd + m6.cdd
    tau1 = C1 / gm1
    tau2 = C2 / gm5

    gain_tot = max(A1 * A2 * max(Ainv, 1.0), 1.0)
    t_lin = (tau1 + tau2) * math.log(max((VDD / 2) / (gain_tot * vod), 1.0))
    t_slew = cl * (VDD / 2) / p["I_inv"]
    tpd = t_lin + t_slew

    power = VDD * (iref + p["I_tail"] + p["I_s2"])

    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd,
        "power": power,
        "polarity_ok": 1.0,
        "A1": A1, "A2": A2, "Ainv": Ainv,
    }
```
